exposure: rs2230806 (R219K) polymorphism in the ABCA1 gene
cohort: The study included 660 pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus and 1,097 pregnant women as control subjects.
finding: The rs2230806 polymorphism in the ABCA1 gene was associated with variations in atherometabolic traits in GDM patients, with characteristics of BMI dependency, but not with GDM.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, with BMI measurements extending up to delivery.
